name: How To Get In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that entrance into heaven is not earned by human works but is granted through faith in Jesus Christ. When asked how to obtain eternal life, Jesus emphasizes the necessity of being born again and believing in Him as the only way to the Father. God's love is demonstrated by giving His only begotten Son so that whoever believes in Him will have everlasting life, while rejection of the Son results in remaining under God's wrath. Jesus clearly states that He is the exclusive way, truth, and life, affirming that no one comes to the Father except through Him.
